desc:
⛏️ Build a mining factory and become the richest miner!

Start with one rock. Mine it, pack the boxes, sell them, and grow a giant factory!

🏭 Build your factory and hire workers
💎 Mine gold, crystals, and rare ores
🚚 Sell with trucks, boats, and planes
☢️ Unlock the nuclear area, the deep mine, the meteor crater, and the airport
👽 Solve the alien mystery: find the ship parts and fly the UFO
🚗 Drive bikes, cars, a 4x4, and a plane to carry more boxes
🎁 Daily rewards and prizes just for playing

👥 NEW: play with friends and earn +10% money for each one (up to +30%)!
🎉 +50% money every weekend

📱 PC, phone, tablet, and console

⭐ Favorite the game and turn on notifications so you don't miss the live events!
👍 Enjoying it? Leave a like!
